title: Balloon Pop
blurb: One sharp burst, and everybody flinches even though they all watched it coming. Nobody gets used to it. That reflex sits below conscious control, which makes the clip genuinely useful: comic for a deflating moment, startling as a jump cut, and ideal for punctuating a celebration about to go badly wrong. Party planners and horror editors reach for the same clip, and that probably tells you something about both professions. Balloons, it turns out, are not a neutral technology.
origin: A close recording of a party balloon bursting.
